_meta.purpose: Paraphrase robustness bank. 5 of the 25 interpretation points are scored on hidden paraphrases of the same rule, so every directive type needs many wordings that the public pack does not contain.
_meta.owner: Member B writes the notes, Member D wires them into tests/test_paraphrase.py
_meta.usage: Each entry is a note plus the ground truth it must resolve to under the battery in `battery_context`. Hours follow the start-inclusive / end-exclusive convention.
_meta.target: at least 12 entries per directive type before submission
_meta.status: 14+ per directive type plus distractors. None is copied from tests/data/public_samples.json. The last 15 cases were first used as a blind holdout (the regex fallback scored 60% on them before any tuning, against 100% on the rest) and are kept as regression cases. Run `python3 -m app.llm.bench fallback` (offline) or `python3 -m app.llm.bench llm` (needs a key) after every prompt edit.
conventions: hours are start-inclusive and end-exclusive: '1 PM to 3 PM' -> [13, 14]
hours are unique ints 0..23 ascending even when the window wraps midnight
factor is the fraction of solar that REMAINS
minimum_energy_kwh is absolute kWh, resolved against battery_context.capacity_kwh
